description: Automated review step that runs linters, type-checkers, and tests after agent task execution, blocks completion on failure, and surfaces results in dashboard.
deviation_notes: Phase 3 backend was already implemented in codebase (review hooks, log serialization, blocker creation, API route) — verified with tests. Added frontend review display (ReviewResults component, useTaskReview hook, Review tab, done-task click-to-review). Fixed startup bug: tracks were never parsed at server start, added loadProjectTracks() call in main.go. Fixed pre-existing test build error (missing os import).
